mentions.heading: Any significant disruption at one of our manufacturing facilities could disrupt our production schedule
mentions.detail: Facilities model/market-specific with interdependencies; cannot easily shift production; weather, climate change, labor, health crises cited
mentions.quote: We may not be able to easily shift production to other facilities or to make up for lost production.

mentions.heading: Unionized hourly workforce under collective bargaining agreements
mentions.detail: Substantially all hourly employees unionized; agreements negotiated including at local facility level
mentions.quote: In addition, substantially all of our hourly employees are represented by unions and covered by collective bargaining agreements that must be negotiated from time-to-time, including at the local facility level.

mentions.heading: Disruption in our suppliers' operations could disrupt our production schedule
mentions.detail: Just-in-time minimal inventory except battery raw material offtakes; some single-source parts; could hit higher margin vehicles
mentions.quote: In some instances, we purchase systems, components, raw materials, and parts that are ultimately derived from a single source and may be at an increased risk for supply disruptions.

mentions.heading: Pandemics and other public health crises could materially adversely impact our business
mentions.detail: COVID-19 previously disrupted operations; could cause loan/lease defaults, lower auction pricing, impaired credit access
mentions.quote: Pandemics, epidemics, or disease outbreaks in the U.S. or globally, such as the COVID-19 pandemic, have previously disrupted, and may in the future disrupt, our business, which could materially affect our results of operations, financial condition, liquidity, and future expectations.

mentions.heading: Competitors may independently develop similar products despite our intellectual property
mentions.quote: Competitors may independently develop products and services similar to ours, and there are no guarantees that GM’s intellectual property rights would prevent competitors from independently developing or selling those products and services.
